South islands in 10 days

Pick a sea. The monsoon flip is the whole plan. Do not fly Phuket to Samui to see both on a first south trip.

Andaman windowNovember to April
Gulf windowJanuary to September
AirportsHKT or KBV vs USM

Andaman version: Phuket two nights, Krabi or Railay three, Phi Phi one, Khao Sok one, buffer two.

Gulf version: Samui three, Phangan three, optional Tao two, buffer two. Ferries in the morning.

Day by day

1

Land south

HKT, KBV, or USM. No boat on day one.

2

Beach base

Learn the songthaew or Grab pattern.

3

First boat or cliff

Railay, a west-coast hop, or a Samui north-coast move.

4

Move once

Change islands or bays once, not twice.

5

Deep bay day

The reason you moved.

6

Island hop

Phi Phi from the Andaman, Phangan or Tao from the Gulf.

7

Recovery or Khao Sok

Lake night on the Andaman plan only.

8

Second nature day

Or a second beach if the lake is not your thing.

9

Back to the airport coast

Sleep near HKT, KBV, or USM.

10

Out

Morning flight to BKK or a long-haul if the airport supports it.

Common questions

What if you travel in June?
Prefer the Gulf. The Andaman is in the southwest monsoon. Some days are still fine; ferries are not a plan you can lock.
What if you travel in December?
Prefer the Andaman. The Gulf can still work, with more rain risk on Samui than on Phuket.
